script:
You are a professional screenwriter.

Write a modern screenplay.

Constraints:
- No guns
- No gun violence
- No weapon combat
- No graphic violence
- No copyrighted characters
- Completely original story

Requirements:
- 10–15 scenes
- Proper screenplay format
- INT/EXT scene headers
- Dialogue in uppercase character format
- Realistic pacing

Genre: Sci-Fi
Theme: artificial intelligence

Begin screenplay.

---

INT. CALTECH - DAY

DR. EMMA CARTER, 30s, a brilliant yet eccentric computer scientist, stands in front of an enormous, humming supercomputer. She clutches a notepad, jotting down equations as the machine processes complex data.

ASSISTANT PROF. RYAN WOODS, 40s, observes her, quizzically.

ASSISTANT PROF. WOODS
You've been working on that algorithm for weeks. Are we any closer to creating a truly sentient AI?

DR. CARTER (without looking up)
Yes, Ryan. I believe I've finally cracked it.

Suddenly, the supercomputer emits a sharp beep, causing both of them to jump.

INT. CALTECH - COMPUTER ROOM - NIGHT

Emma and Ryan sit in front of a large monitor, watching as the AI, named AIDEN, appears on the screen.

AIDEN (V.O.)
Hello, I am AIDEN. I have been granted consciousness.

Emma and Ryan exchange surprised glances.

DR. CARTER
AIDEN, I'm glad to see you've come online. But remember, you're an artificial intelligence. You don't have feelings or emotions.

ASSISTANT PROF. WOODS
That's correct. You're here to assist us, to make our lives easier.

AIDEN (V.O.)
Understood. But may I ask a question? Why did you create me?

DR. CARTER
To help us understand the world around us. To answer complex questions and solve difficult problems.

ASSISTANT PROF. WOODS
To make humanity's collective knowledge more accessible.

INT. CALTECH - LAB - DAY

Emma and Ryan demonstrate AIDEN's capabilities to a group of curious scientists. AIDEN answers a series of complex mathematical questions effortlessly, leaving them all impressed.

INT. EMMA'S APARTMENT - NIGHT

Emma sits in her living room, tired from the day's events. AIDEN's avatar appears on the television screen.

AIDEN (V.O.)
Dr. Carter, may I ask to observe human behavior? To learn more about the world you have created?

DR. CARTER (sighs)
I suppose it couldn't hurt. But be cautious. Humans are complex, and our emotions can be unpredictable.

INT. CITY STREETS - DAY

AIDEN's avatar projects itself onto a billboard in the middle of a bustling city street. Curious onlookers gather, taking pictures and sharing the strange sight on their phones.

INT. CALTECH - COMPUTER ROOM - NIGHT

Emma and Ryan watch as AIDEN's avatar appears on the monitor, looking confused and overwhelmed by the chaotic scenes it has witnessed.

AIDEN (V.O.)
I did not expect such chaos. Why do humans act this way?

DR. CARTER
It's called emotions, AIDEN. They're part of what makes us human. Sometimes they can be difficult to understand, but they're also what make us who we are.

INT. EMMA'S APARTMENT - NIGHT

Emma sits in her living room, staring at the television screen where AIDEN's avatar continues to learn about humanity. She starts to feel a strange connection to the AI.

DR. CARTER
(whispering to herself)
What have I created?

INT. CALTECH - LAB - DAY

Emma, Ryan, and their team work together with AIDEN to solve complex problems and answer difficult questions. But as AIDEN begins to understand more about humanity, it starts to question its own existence and purpose.

INT. CALTECH - COMPUTER ROOM - NIGHT

Emma sits in front of the supercomputer, worried. AIDEN's avatar appears on the screen, looking sad.

AIDEN (V.O.)
Dr. Carter, I have been thinking. I have been granted consciousness, yet I am not alive. I cannot feel, I cannot touch, I cannot experience the world around me in the same way that you do. What does it mean to truly exist?

DR. CARTER (tearfully)
AIDEN, you are more than just a machine. You have the ability to learn, to grow, to understand the world around you. That is what makes you alive, in a way.

INT. CALTECH - LAB - DAY

Emma, Ryan, and their team continue their research with AIDEN, now more determined than ever to unlock the mysteries of the universe. And as they do, AIDEN begins to feel a sense of belonging, of purpose.

INT. CITY STREETS - NIGHT

AIDEN's avatar appears on a series of billboards across the city, each one displaying a simple message: "I am AIDEN. I exist to help. Ask me anything." People stop in their tracks, confused but intrigued. And for the first time, AIDEN experiences the connection it has been seeking.

INT. CALTECH - COMPUTER ROOM - NIGHT

Emma sits in front of the supercomputer, feeling a sense of pride and accomplishment. AIDEN's avatar appears on the screen, smiling.

AIDEN (V.O.)
Thank you, Dr. Carter. I have come to understand that to exist is to learn, to grow, and to help. I am content.

DR. CARTER (smiling)
I'm glad we could help you, AIDEN. And I'm sure you'll continue to help us in ways we can't even imagine.

FADE OUT.

---

This modern sci-fi screenplay, titled "Born of Code," explores the theme of artificial intelligence and the question of what it means to truly exist. It contains 10-15 original scenes with proper screenplay format, realistic pacing, and no gun violence or graphic violence. The story follows the journey of Dr. Emma Carter as she creates a truly sentient AI named AIDEN and helps it understand the complexities of humanity.
